name: Cosmic Soul Expert
body:
Through your natural talent and hard work, your projected consciousness continuously delves deeper to reveal more secrets of the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Wis 18, Cosmic Soul Adept, and 13 ranks in Spellcraft.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the divine senses ability.

Except as described below, your divine senses otherwise function as cosmic senses from the Cosmic Soul Adept feat (including sharing the same daily uses and how to regain a daily use).

Divine Senses (Su)

Your activated cosmic senses, now known as divine senses, have evolved to collect additional information and perceive the world with greater insight. While your divine senses are active, you may spend a swift action to gain the benefits of analyze aura on a number of observed targets equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Unlike analyze aura, the auras you can read on a target require a minimum number of ranks in Spellcraft (see below). You gain the additional information from all unlocked upgrades simultaneously on all of your selected targets for the round. Each upgrade is a sensory acuity usable with your divine senses.

13 Ranks: You can read the target’s “magic aura.”
14 Ranks: You can read the target’s “alignment aura.”
15 Ranks: You can read the “emotion aura.” The circumstance bonus from reading the target’s emotion aura is instead equal to your HD when making Sense Motive skill checks related to the target (up to 1 hour after reading the target’s emotion aura).
16 Ranks: You can read the “health aura.”
17 Ranks: You can read a new aura known as the “mind aura.” Reading a target’s mind aura functions as if you have a constant detect thoughts spell in effect and have spent 3 rounds concentrating on the target. A target can resist this effect each round with a successful Will save (DC 10 + effective spell level of your divine senses + your Wisdom modifier). Unlike reading the other auras, you can only read the mind aura of one of the targets you selected each round with divine senses in this way.
